Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a short RFP and a proposed agenda for a 45-minute demo that would cover:
- Redwood platform overview and where we fit in the inference stack
- Live demo: batch & realtime throughput, latency controls, and routing policies
- Integrations: S3/KMS and your data flow questions
- Next steps & pilot scope (KPIs + mutual action plan)

Would either of these windows work for the demo next week?
- Option A: Tuesday, Feb 24 — 10:00–10:45 PT
- Option B: Wednesday, Feb 25 — 13:00–13:45 PT

If neither works, happy to send a few other slots or we can tentatively pencil something in for early March. Attach: Atlas_RFP_Q1.pdf
